tasks.title: Viral scorer Python script — scripts/scs001/viral-scorer.py
tasks.description: Create scripts/scs001/viral-scorer.py. New Python file, <120 lines. Implement 3 functions: (1) scene_density(video_path: str) -> float — uses scenedetect to count scene changes, returns 0-1 normalised density score. (2) audio_excitement(video_path: str) -> float — uses librosa to analyse audio energy + tempo, returns 0-1. (3) clip_topic_alignment(video_path: str, topics: list[str]) -> float — extracts 1 frame per second, encodes with open_clip (ViT-B-32, openai), computes cosine similarity vs topic text embeddings, returns 0-1. Main block: reads JSON from stdin {video_path: str, topics: list[str]}, computes all 3 scores, computes partial_viral_score = clip_topic_alignment*0.35 + audio_excitement*0.35 + scene_density*0.30, writes JSON to stdout {scene_density_score, audio_excitement, clip_topic_alignment, partial_viral_score}. Graceful degradation: if any dep is missing (ImportError), set that score to 0.5 and log a warning to stderr — never crash. If video_path doesn't exist, return all 0.5 scores. Requires: pip3 install scenedetect librosa open-clip-torch pillow
tasks.context: Sprint 186, Viral Detection Week 1. Viral Detection Upgrade Report specifies 9-method cascade. Week 1 = 3 quick wins. This is a NEW file — do not modify any existing files. tasks.title: Viral scorer TypeScript wrapper — scripts/scs001/viral-scorer.ts
tasks.description: Create scripts/scs001/viral-scorer.ts. New TypeScript file, <100 lines. Export interface ViralScoreResult { scene_density_score: number; audio_excitement: number; clip_topic_alignment: number; partial_viral_score: number; error?: string; }. Export class ViralScorer with method: async score(videoPath: string, topics: string[]): Promise<ViralScoreResult>. Implementation: use child_process.spawn to run python3 scripts/scs001/viral-scorer.py. Send JSON {video_path: videoPath, topics} to stdin. Read stdout. Parse JSON. Return ViralScoreResult. Timeout: 30000ms. On timeout/error/parse-fail: return {scene_density_score: 0.5, audio_excitement: 0.5, clip_topic_alignment: 0.5, partial_viral_score: 0.5, error: err.message}. Log all errors to console.warn — never throw. Export singleton: export const viralScorer = new ViralScorer(). Use only Node.js stdlib (child_process, path — NO npm packages).
